purpose: Separate scene/noise sensitivity from rendering changes and overfitting of task-specific adapter restrictions
rendering: Initialize OpenGL before importing/loading Torch; record actual renderer for every episode

conditions.suction_upright: Existing global default: 15 mm / 0.10 rad Cartesian caps, 0.12 rad joint-target slew, eight-degree upright guard
conditions.reference_scale_audit: Same calibrated cameras, 50 mm / 0.5 rad reference scaling per axis; norm caps sqrt(3) times these scales remove extra norm clipping; no upright guard; retain the same joint/actuator/workspace limits

interpretation: No per-seed retuning or post-hoc choice of a winning profile. These are development ablations, not a held-out success-rate evaluation. Lack of seed-conditioned code does not by itself rule out hyperparameter overfitting.
